# Raw Commands E2E — full end-to-end flow for raw operations

# === INIT ===

exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

# === RAW WRITE ===

# Write multiple raw files
stdin ../csv-input.txt
exec akb raw write data.csv
stdout 'Written to raw/data.csv'

stdin ../logo-input.txt
exec akb raw write images/logo.png
stdout 'Written to raw/images/logo.png'

stdin ../config-input.txt
exec akb raw write config/settings.ini
stdout 'Written to raw/config/settings.ini'

# === RAW LIST ===

# List shows all files alphabetically
exec akb raw list
stdout 'config/settings.ini'
stdout 'data.csv'
stdout 'images/logo.png'

# List excludes files.log
exec akb raw list
! stdout 'files.log'

# === RAW READ ===

# Read each file correctly
exec akb raw read data.csv
stdout 'hello,world'

exec akb raw read images/logo.png
stdout 'logodata'

exec akb raw read config/settings.ini
stdout 'key=value'

# Read with raw/ prefix
exec akb raw read raw/data.csv
stdout 'hello,world'

# === RAW STATUS — NO DRIFT ===

exec akb raw status
stdout 'no drift'

# === DRIFT DETECTION ===

# Modify file externally → drift detected
cp ../modified-input.txt raw/data.csv
! exec akb raw status
stdout 'MODIFIED data.csv'
! stdout 'UNTRACKED'
! stdout 'MISSING'

# Drift exits with code 1
! exec akb raw status

# Create untracked file
exec bash -c 'echo "untracked" > raw/untracked.txt'
! exec akb raw status
stdout 'UNTRACKED untracked.txt'

# Delete tracked file → missing
rm raw/config/settings.ini
! exec akb raw status
stdout 'MISSING config/settings.ini'

# === RAW SYNC — FIX DRIFT ===

exec akb raw sync
stdout 'Synced'

# Verify sync fixed drift
exec akb raw status
stdout 'no drift'

# Sync on clean state reports no changes
exec akb raw sync
stdout 'No changes to sync.'

# === RAW DELETE ===

# Write a file for deletion
stdin ../csv-input.txt
exec akb raw write temp.txt
stdout 'Written to raw/temp.txt'

# Delete the file
exec akb raw delete temp.txt
stdout 'Deleted raw/temp.txt'

# Verify file removed from disk
! exists raw/temp.txt

# Verify manifest entry removed
exec akb raw list
! stdout 'temp.txt'

# === SOURCES SCAN WARNING ===

# Write a raw file and create a KB page referencing it
stdin ../csv-input.txt
exec akb raw write data.csv
stdout 'Written to raw/data.csv'

stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write source-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/source-note.md'

# Delete the raw file — should warn about source reference
exec akb raw delete data.csv
stdout 'Deleted raw/data.csv'
stdout 'Pages referencing this file: notes/source-note.md'

# === CROSS-NAMESPACE GUARDS ===

# Block raw/ prefix on regular write
stdin ../note-input.md
! exec akb write raw/notes/test.md
stderr 'akb raw write'

# Block raw/ prefix on regular read
! exec akb read raw/notes/test.md
stderr 'akb raw read'

# Block raw/ prefix on regular delete
! exec akb delete raw/notes/test.md
stderr 'akb raw delete'

# Block raw/ prefix on regular append
stdin ../append-input.md
! exec akb append raw/notes/test.md
stderr 'akb raw write'

# Block kb/ prefix on raw write
stdin ../csv-input.txt
! exec akb raw write kb/test.md
stderr 'akb write'

# Block kb/ prefix on raw read
! exec akb raw read kb/test.md
stderr 'akb read'

# === --no-commit FLAG ===

# Write with --no-commit
stdin ../csv-input.txt
exec akb raw write nocommit.txt --no-commit
stdout 'Written to raw/nocommit.txt'

# Verify file exists
exists raw/nocommit.txt

# Verify no git commit was created for the write
exec git status --short
stdout 'raw/nocommit.txt'

# Sync with --no-commit
exec bash -c 'echo "external" > raw/external.txt'
exec akb raw sync --no-commit
stdout 'Synced'

# Delete with --no-commit
exec akb raw delete nocommit.txt --no-commit
stdout 'Deleted raw/nocommit.txt'

! exists raw/nocommit.txt

-- csv-input.txt --
hello,world

-- logo-input.txt --
logodata

-- config-input.txt --
key=value

-- modified-input.txt --
modified content

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Data Source Note
sources: data.csv
---
Note referencing data.csv

-- append-input.md --
Appended content
